With 5% of profits contributed towards educating and empowering underprivileged children, each bottle of this hair oil can impact the lives of children across India, making you an agent of positive change. Experience the transformative power of Nihar Naturals Badam & Amla Hair Oil and unlock the secret to beautiful, nourished hair.

title: Naturals Amla Gold Hair Oil with Amla & 7 Seeds

details.description: Over the last two decades, Nihar Naturals has established its name and trust in one of the most popular hair oil segments, Amla. Owing to this trust and to upgrade the consumers' experience of using an Amla hair oil, Nihar Naturals is launching a new, premium, quality hair oil, Nihar Naturals Amla Gold Hair Oil - with Amla & 7 Seeds. This potent oil is made with Amla oil and a unique mix of 7 seeds - Grape Seed, White Sesame Seed, Sunflower Seed, Chia Seed, Cucumber Seed, Pomegranate Seed & Watermelon Seed - which, through a unique nourish tube, consistently infuses nutrients into the oil, giving you black, thick & strong hair. This non-sticky hair oil has the goodness of the above natural ingredients with no added parabens, silicones or sulphates. It has a mild, pleasant and soothing fragrance and works well on all types of hair. Just take a few drops of oil and massage into the scalp and hair, leave overnight and rinse off the next day for best results.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Take a few drops of oil & massage into the scalp & hair.
2. Leave overnight for best results.
details.storageInstructions: *Store in a cool & dry place protected from light

title: Naturals Almond Non Sticky Hair Oil with Vitamin E

details.description:
Almond Oil or Badam Oil contains essential fatty acids, Vitamin E and other Phytonutrients and is known for Anti-Oxidant and Anti-inflammation benefits. Vitamin E is a strong Anti-Oxidant that helps to promote hair growth and makes hair stronger. Essential fatty acids of Almond oil have very good emollient properties, which helps to soften and moisturize dry hair. It is also used to stimulate hair growth and makes hair strong.
Nihar Naturals Almond Hair Oil is a new hair oil launch from the trusted Nihar Naturals brand. Nihar Natural Almond Hair Oil is infused with Natural Almond Oil and Vitamin E, which helps to nourish your hair. Use of Nihar Natural Almond Hair Oil makes hair strand moisturised, soft, and strong. Along with stronger* hair, also it provides 2X softness* and 3X shine*.
The bottle packaging is premium and comes in a plastic packaging, which is convenient to handle. Pour a few drops in your hand and apply to the hair gently from the scalp till the tip of the hair. It is suitable to apply for all types of hair.
details.usageInstructions: Pour a few drops in your hand and apply to the hair gently from the scalp till the tip of the hair.
